ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs With Uncommon Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities with an uncommon extension.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\Regsvcs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Regasm\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "RegSvcs\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RegAsm\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*")))
